description: A cookbook, published by the Ladies Aid Society of the M.E. Church in 1907, includes recipes for salads, breads, seafood, meats, vegetables, desserts, and canned foods contributed by women of the San Juan Islands, and pages of advertisements for local businesses. It is accompanied by an interview with Fran Chevalier about the cookbook and living on San Juan Island.
